tasks.description: Design and create a basic dashboard layout for reports. This will involve setting up the initial UI components and framework. The dashboard should be able to display multiple reports and have a basic navigation system.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is logged in, when they navigate to the reports section, then the dashboard is displayed with a list of available reports.

tasks.description: Develop the functionality to display reports on the dashboard. This involves integrating the report data with the dashboard UI and ensuring that reports can be rendered correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Given a report is selected, when the dashboard is refreshed, then the report data is displayed correctly.

tasks.description: Develop the navigation system for the reports dashboard. This involves creating a menu or other navigation elements that allow users to select and view different reports.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is on the dashboard, when they select a different report from the navigation menu, then the selected report is displayed.
